articles.title_en: À la carte Management of Recreational Resources
articles.title_cn: 休闲资源的点菜式管理
articles.abstract_en:
Abstract

Externalities from recreation scale at both the extensive and intensive margins of resource interaction. Recreators have differentiated demands for these margins, so unbundling the prices of access and intensive depletion could improve upon traditional management. We use choice experiment data from US Gulf of Mexico recreational headboat anglers to estimate structural models of trip and red snapper retention demand, then simulate aggregate harvest across a range of trip and harvest tag prices. In our simulations, the red snapper harvest tag market equilibrates at $15 per tag and generates $760,000 in management revenues per year while more efficiently allocating harvest.
articles.abstract_cn: 休闲活动的外部性在资源互动的广度和强度边际上均有所体现。休闲者对这两个边际的需求存在差异，因此将进入价格与强度消耗价格解绑可能优于传统管理方式。我们利用美国墨西哥湾休闲头船垂钓者的选择实验数据，估计了出行和红鲷鱼保留需求的结构模型，然后模拟了一系列出行和捕捞标签价格下的总捕捞量。在我们的模拟中，红鲷鱼捕捞标签市场在每张标签15美元的价格下达到均衡，每年产生760,000美元的管理收入，同时更有效地分配捕捞量。

articles.title_en: Temporal Reliability of Contingent Behavior Trip Data in Kuhn-Tucker Recreation Demand Models
articles.title_cn: Kuhn-Tucker休闲需求模型中条件行为出行数据的时间可靠性
articles.abstract_en:
Abstract

Contingent behavior (CB) trip data, eliciting intended trip decisions with hypothetical scenarios, has been popular in recreation demand models. Unlike other stated preference methods, the temporal reliability of CB data has not been examined in recreation demand models, especially in a Kuhn-Tucker (KT) framework. This paper assesses the temporal reliability of CB trip data collected over three years in KT models. We find that coefficient and welfare estimates are largely reliable over time. Our findings add confidence in using CB trip data to model demands within and beyond recreation contexts and provide insight into the broader application of KT models.
articles.abstract_cn: 条件行为（CB）出行数据通过假设情景引出预期出行决策，在休闲需求模型中广受欢迎。与其他陈述偏好方法不同，CB数据的时间可靠性在休闲需求模型中尚未得到检验，尤其是在Kuhn-Tucker（KT）框架下。本文评估了在KT模型中三年内收集的CB出行数据的时间可靠性。我们发现系数和福利估计随时间大致可靠。我们的发现增强了在休闲情境内外使用CB出行数据建模需求的信心，并为KT模型的更广泛应用提供了见解。

articles.title_cn: 环境规制中的酌情豁免
articles.abstract_en:
Abstract

Many environmental regulations impose limits on harmful activities yet include discretionary “safety valve” provisions allowing the regulator to grant exemptions that provide relief to regulated parties. We construct a theoretical model and explore cases in which this discretion serves good or ill. We show that when a regulation is otherwise inflexible, exemptions can improve social welfare, and perhaps reduce pollution, by distributing abatement more cost-effectively across polluters. However, these beneficial predictions rely on an unconstrained, fully informed, and benevolent regulator. In other cases, exemptions may not offer such gains; further, the discretionary nature of exemptions allows them to be abused.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多环境规制对有害活动施加限制，但包含酌情“安全阀”条款，允许监管者授予豁免，为受规制方提供救济。我们构建了一个理论模型，并探讨了这种酌情权在何种情况下产生善果或恶果。我们表明，当规制在其他方面缺乏灵活性时，豁免可以通过在污染者之间更经济有效地分配减排来提高社会福利，并可能减少污染。然而，这些有益的预测依赖于一个不受约束、信息充分且仁慈的监管者。在其他情况下，豁免可能不会带来此类收益；此外，豁免的酌情性质使其可能被滥用。

articles.abstract_en:
Abstract

Using the National Pollution Discharge Elimination System compliance and the Clean Water State Revolving Funds (CWSRF) data for wastewater treatment plants in nine states between 2010 and 2018, we examine a) the effect of non-compliance on the distribution and size of awarded CWSRF loans, and b) the effects of the CWSRF provision and award size on post-funding compliance. We observe that funded facilities have poorer compliance records than the unfunded ones and that funded facilities decrease violations within two years after receiving financial support. On average, a $50 million CWSRF loan decreases violations by one count within two post-funding years.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用2010年至2018年间九个州污水处理厂的国家污染物排放消除系统合规数据以及清洁水州立滚动基金（CWSRF）数据，我们考察了a）不合规对CWSRF贷款分配和规模的影响，以及b）CWSRF提供和贷款规模对资助后合规的影响。我们观察到，获得资助的设施比未获得资助的设施有更差的合规记录，并且获得资助的设施在获得财政支持后的两年内违规行为减少。平均而言，一笔50万美元的CWSRF贷款在资助后两年内使违规行为减少一次。

articles.title_en: Certainty of Punishment versus Severity of Punishment
articles.title_cn: 惩罚的确定性对惩罚的严厉性
articles.abstract_en:
Abstract

According to the standard enforcement model, the key deterrence components are punishment certainty and severity. While theory predicts the relative efficacy of certainty versus severity, empirical and experimental evidence are mixed. Our study represents the first to systematically compare the effects of certainty and severity in the environmental protection context. Our empirics examine wastewater discharged by chemical manufacturing facilities permitted under the Clean Water Act. We find that, when enforcement certainty and severity are high, both components effectively deter pollution, with certainty more effective. In contrast, certainty and severity increases prove counter-productive when certainty and severity are low.
articles.abstract_cn: 根据标准执法模型，关键的威慑组成部分是惩罚的确定性和严厉性。虽然理论预测了确定性与严厉性的相对效力，但实证和实验证据却参差不齐。我们的研究首次系统地比较了环境保护背景下确定性和严厉性的效果。我们的实证研究考察了根据《清洁水法》许可的化学制造设施排放的废水。我们发现，当执法确定性和严厉性较高时，这两个组成部分都能有效威慑污染，其中确定性更为有效。相比之下，当确定性和严厉性较低时，增加确定性和严厉性反而会适得其反。

articles.title_cn: 光伏发电与太阳能反弹
articles.abstract_en:
Abstract

Recent research suggests that households increase their electricity consumption after installing photovoltaic (PV) panels, a behavioral change commonly referred to as the solar rebound. Using panel data originating from the German Residential Energy Consumption Survey (GRECS), we investigate the existence of a solar rebound effect. Our empirical results suggest that PV panel adoption does not change the amount of electricity that households take from the grid. As we derive theoretically, this implies a solar rebound that is bounded from above by about 50%, while back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest a lower bound of 12% and an average solar rebound of 35%.
articles.abstract_cn: 近期研究表明，家庭在安装光伏（PV）面板后会增加其电力消耗，这种行为变化通常被称为太阳能反弹。利用来自德国住宅能源消费调查（GRECS）的面板数据，我们研究了太阳能反弹效应的存在性。我们的实证结果表明，光伏面板的采用并未改变家庭从电网获取的电量。正如我们在理论上推导的那样，这意味着太阳能反弹的上限约为50%，而粗略计算表明其下限为12%，平均太阳能反弹为35%。

articles.title_en: Homeowner Subsidy Repeal and Housing Recentralization
articles.title_cn: 房主补贴取消与城市再中心化
articles.abstract_en:
Abstract

Subsidizing homeownership decentralizes cities, so Muth (1967) suggested over half a century ago. This paper’s interest is in the related question of whether repealing a homeownership subsidy recentralizes cities. This question is relevant today, given homeownership subsidies’ ubiquity. We provide a first quasi-experimental test of a subsidy repeal’s spatial effects by turning to Germany’s 2005 homeownership subsidy reform. We find that repealing the subsidy contributed to recentralizing Germany’s cities. Inasmuch as recentralization helps abate carbon dioxide emissions, repealing a homeownership subsidy also helps mitigate global warming.
articles.abstract_cn: 补贴购房会使城市分散化，这是穆特（1967）在半个多世纪前提出的观点。本文关注的相关问题是，取消购房补贴是否会使城市再中心化。鉴于购房补贴的普遍性，这一问题在今天具有现实意义。我们利用德国2005年的购房补贴改革，首次对取消补贴的空间效应进行了准实验检验。我们发现，取消补贴促进了德国城市的再中心化。鉴于再中心化有助于减少二氧化碳排放，取消购房补贴也有助于缓解全球变暖。

articles.title_en: Tenant Favoritism and Right of First Refusals in Farmland Auctions
articles.title_cn: 农田拍卖中的租户偏袒与优先购买权
articles.abstract_en:
Abstract

Rights of First Refusals (RFRs) granted to tenants in land privatization auctions enable them to purchase their leased land by accepting the highest bid. RFRs may however deter bidders and incentivize non-right holders to adjust their bidding. We conjecture that tenant favoritism with RFRs reduces competition and thus sales prices at the expense of the public sellers. To test the conjectures, we compile a dataset of land auctions by two privatization agencies in eastern Germany, one favoring tenants along with an RFR, between 2007 and 2018. Double-robust matching results indicate RFR-related reductions in the number of bidders and prices.
articles.abstract_cn: 在土地私有化拍卖中，授予租户的优先购买权使他们能够通过接受最高出价来购买其租赁土地。然而，优先购买权可能会阻止竞标者，并激励非权利持有者调整其出价。我们推测，带有优先购买权的租户偏袒会减少竞争，从而以公共卖方的利益为代价降低销售价格。为检验这些推测，我们编制了东德两家私有化机构在2007年至2018年间土地拍卖的数据集，其中一家机构在提供优先购买权的同时偏袒租户。双重稳健匹配结果表明，优先购买权相关因素导致竞标者数量和价格下降。
